notes.title: Fake Colours....Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,


So, we have finally gotten some time to get back around to taking your feedback on Fake Colours. There is an update in the work that will fix Camera, UI elements and maybe even a little something extra. :) Hang tight and keep an eye out!

Thanks

The Fake Colours Team

notes.title: Another update in the works
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We are actively working on giving you some features you have been requesting. We are working right now on a better camera control system and adding a few more languages. We always are listening to what you guys want and trying to meet those request.  We hope you are enjoying the game and look forward to giving you an even better experience. 

The Forthright Team

notes.title: Game Launch Event Party
notes.content:
We are going to be doing a launch party for the game on January 1st. We will be givinig away Steam games to random reviewers of the game. We will be giving away games at different sale intervals on our opening two days. Those will be 1000 copies purchased*, 2500 copies purchased*, 5000 copies purchased* and if we reach 10,000 purchases* on launch day, one winner will win a Grand Prize! A 20 GAME MEGA PACK!

Games to be giving away on January 16th. So make sure you start sharing the word! 

Those title will include the following titles:
1.) Far Cry 4 
2.) Outlast 
3.) The Escapists 
4.) Call of Duty Advanced Warfare 
5.) theHunter: Primal
6.) The Talos Principle
7.) Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel
8.) Metro Redux Bundle
9.) Lichdom: Battlemage
10.) 7 Days To Die
11.) Endless Legend 
12.) Shadows: Heretic Kingdoms
13.) AwesomeNauts
14.) Orion: Prelude
15.) Dino D-Day
16.) Chivarly
17.) Super Hexagon
18.) Murder Miners
19.) LISA
20.) Speed Runners


*Purchases are required to be bought through Steam and does not include in Greenlight Bundles, or copies purchased through another site.
